residuum.config.title: Residuum
residuum.preview.title: Preview
residuum.config.intro: Point at a setting, or pick one with Tab and the arrow keys, to see here what it does. Changes take effect at once and are saved when you leave; Ctrl+Z undoes them one by one.
residuum.preview.hold_shift: Hold Shift to see the default
residuum.config.applied: Applied. Ctrl+Z or Undo puts your settings back
residuum.config.copied: Copied: paste it in a chat or a file for someone
residuum.config.pasted: Pasted %s settings. Ctrl+Z or Undo puts yours back
residuum.config.paste_none: The clipboard has no Residuum settings in it
residuum.option.preset_subtle.tooltip: Lighter fog and dust, marks that go sooner, no tumbleweeds: the effects are there, but you have to look for them.
residuum.option.preset_standard.tooltip: Every setting at its default, as Residuum comes.
residuum.option.preset_maximum.tooltip: Thicker fog and dust, more tumbleweeds, marks that stay much longer, and windows found further away. Needs a little more from your computer.
residuum.option.preset_low_end.tooltip: Windows found and drawn closer to you only, fewer kept at once, no tumbleweeds or trampled grass: the effects of the default, for much less work.
residuum.option.copy.tooltip: Puts the settings you changed from the defaults in the clipboard as one line of text, to send to a friend or keep in a file.
residuum.option.paste.tooltip: Takes settings someone copied from the clipboard: the defaults, with what they changed. Anything that is not a Residuum setting is left out, and values are kept within each setting's range.
residuum.option.enabled.tooltip: Turns every effect on or off. A key for this can be set in the Controls screen.
residuum.option.condensation.tooltip: Fog forms on the warm side of glass when it is cold outside, warm in lamplight. Thick fog gathers into drops that run down it.
residuum.option.frost.tooltip: Fogged glass freezes over with frost when it is below freezing outside.
residuum.option.ice.tooltip: While it snows, feathery ice grows up the outside of windows from the bottom, and at half the pace on freezing nights.
residuum.option.sand.tooltip: In deserts, a barely visible film of sandy dust covers the outside of windows, with a thin deposit along the bottom, a little more at night. Red dust in badlands.
residuum.option.skylights.tooltip: Glass in a roof or ceiling, with the sky above and a room below, fogs and frosts underneath and gathers ice and dust on top. A room under a glass roof counts as indoors.
residuum.option.torch_soot.tooltip: A torch smudges the underside of the block over it with soot, half as much on a block one higher. It builds up over a torch put in, and fades slowly once the torch is gone.
residuum.option.shield_scratches.tooltip: When an axe knocks a shield aside, yours or anyone else's, it leaves a gash across its front that fades as the shield comes back.
residuum.option.tumbleweeds.tooltip: Now and then a tumbleweed rolls across a desert or badlands, never closer than 16 blocks when it turns up. It is made of dead bush twigs or pale dry grass, and rolls a third slower by day. It hops as it rolls, falls off edges, bounces back off walls but never rolls up onto anything, kicks up dust where it lands, and a hit breaks it up.
residuum.option.footprints.tooltip: Players and mobs leave footprints in snow and sand as they walk: boot prints from people, paw prints from animals. They fade away after a while.
residuum.option.mob_footprints.tooltip: Mobs and animals round you leave footprints as well, not only players. Switch off if a crowded farm in the snow gets busy.
residuum.option.footprint_time.tooltip: How long a footprint stays before it is gone.
residuum.option.leave_prints.tooltip: %s is installed, and it leaves footprints too. While this is on, Residuum leaves no footprints of its own, so there are not two of every step. Switch it off to have Residuum leave them as well.
residuum.option.cracks.tooltip: An arrow or trident that sticks in glass cracks it round the spot it went in, a web you can see from both sides. The crack goes once the glass is broken or replaced, or after a while.
residuum.option.crack_time.tooltip: How long a crack stays in the glass, and an arrow's hole in a block.
residuum.option.arrow_holes.tooltip: An arrow or trident that sticks in a block other than glass leaves a small chipped hole where it went in, which stays after it is pulled out and fades away after a while.
residuum.option.hoarfrost.tooltip: On clear nights cold enough to freeze, the tops of grass, leaves, moss and podzol out under the sky slowly frost over white, in crystals that gather in patches. In the morning sun it goes again.
residuum.option.wall_snow.tooltip: In a blizzard the wind drives snow onto the walls of what is built out in the open, a flake at a time: thick on the walls that face it, a little on those it blows along. It lies on what you see of a block and runs on a little onto the faces beside it; the ground of the land, glass and lit lamps stay bare. Once the snow stops it slowly falls away. The wind turns every ten minutes or so.
residuum.option.wall_snow_storms.tooltip: Snow sticks to walls only in a thunderstorm, when the wind is strong enough to drive it there. Switch off to have it build up in any snowfall.
residuum.option.wall_snow_amount.tooltip: How much of a wall the snow covers once it has built up. 100% is about a third of a wall facing the wind.
residuum.option.wall_snow_sides.tooltip: How much snow the walls the wind blows along get, of what the walls facing it get.
residuum.option.wall_snow_build.tooltip: How long snow takes to build up on a wall in full.
residuum.option.wall_snow_melt.tooltip: How long snow takes to fall off the walls once the snowfall is over.
residuum.option.snow_caps.tooltip: While it snows, snow settles in clumps on the tops of stairs, slabs, fences and walls out under the sky, which the game's own snow leaves bare, and drapes a little over their edges.
residuum.option.snow_caps_stay.tooltip: Snow on ledges stays after the snowfall, as the snow on the ground does. Switch off to have it fall away with the snow on walls.
residuum.option.snow_caps_build.tooltip: How long snow takes to settle on a ledge in full.
residuum.option.hoarfrost_build.tooltip: How long hoarfrost takes to whiten the grass in full on a frosty night.
residuum.option.steam.tooltip: Water that lava or magma heats from a block or two away, under the bed of a pond or behind its bank, gives off wisps of steam, more the nearer the heat.
residuum.option.fireflies.tooltip: On dry nights that are not cold, fireflies glow and drift over grass, ferns and flowers under the open sky: green-blue in cool places, yellow-green in mild ones, amber where it is hot. They come out little by little as night falls, thin out toward dawn, and keep away from torches and lamps.
residuum.option.firefly_count.tooltip: How many fireflies come out. 100% is some forty round you over a meadow.
residuum.option.tumbleweed_frequency.too: How often tumbleweeds turn up. 100% is about one every 20 seconds, two at most at once.
residuum.option.raindrops.tooltip: Drops run down glass that the rain falls on. In a snowfall flakes stick to it, twice as many in a storm.
residuum.option.breath_spot.tooltip: In the cold, your breath fogs the glass where you look, when your face is close to it.
residuum.option.wipe.tooltip: Right-click fog or frost with an empty hand to wipe a patch clear.
residuum.option.tint_stained_glass.toolt: Fog takes a faint colour from stained glass.
residuum.option.ash.tooltip: Fire chars the block it burns on and leaves soot on the blocks around it.
residuum.option.snowballs.tooltip: Snowballs leave splats on blocks and on raised shields.
residuum.option.lightning.tooltip: Lightning leaves a burn mark on the ground and melts sand into glass. A lightning rod it strikes crackles with little bolts for a while after.
residuum.option.trampling.tooltip: Grass and ferns you walk through lie down the way you went, and spring back up half a second after you have gone.
residuum.option.leave_glass.tooltip: %s is installed, and it puts weather on windows too. While this is on, Residuum leaves fog, frost, ice, dust and raindrops on glass to it, so they are not drawn twice; its marks, grass and the rest stay. Switch it off to have Residuum draw the windows as well.
residuum.option.leave_grass.tooltip: %s is installed, and it bends grass as things move through it. While this is on, Residuum does not trample grass itself, so the two do not fight over the same plants. Switch it off to trample grass with Residuum instead.
residuum.option.explosions.tooltip: TNT, creepers, end crystals, beds and other explosions blacken the crater they leave and the blocks around it.
residuum.option.fog_strength.tooltip: How thick fog gets. 100% is the default.
residuum.option.fog_build.tooltip: How long fog takes to fully form on cold glass.
residuum.option.fog_clear.tooltip: How long fog takes to clear once the glass is warm again.
residuum.option.frost_build.tooltip: How long frost takes to grow over the glass.
residuum.option.frost_melt.tooltip: How long frost takes to melt away once it is warm.
residuum.option.ice_build.tooltip: How long ice takes to cover a window from the outside while it snows.
residuum.option.ice_fogged.tooltip: The same for glass that is fogged from inside, where ice grows faster.
residuum.option.dust_strength.tooltip: How much dust settles on desert windows. 100% is the default.
residuum.option.dust_build.tooltip: How long dust takes to settle on a desert window. It goes again at the pace of ice build-up.
residuum.option.drying.tooltip: How long drops stay on the glass once the rain stops.
residuum.option.melt.tooltip: How long a window takes to melt into its new frame when a neighbouring window is built or broken.
residuum.option.ash_build.tooltip: How long ash takes to build up on the block under or behind a fire.
residuum.option.ash_side.tooltip: How long ash takes to build up on blocks next to a fire.
residuum.option.ash_fade.tooltip: How long ash takes to fade once the fire is out.
residuum.option.snow.tooltip: How long a snowball splat stays before it melts away.
residuum.option.lightning_time.tooltip: How long a lightning burn mark stays on the ground.
residuum.option.blast_time.tooltip: How long the soot of an explosion stays before it fades like ash.
residuum.option.comfort_temp.tooltip: The outside temperature, on the biome scale, below which glass starts to fog. Higher fogs more.
residuum.option.night_penalty.tooltip: How much colder it counts at night.
residuum.option.rain_penalty.tooltip: How much colder it counts while it rains.
residuum.option.heat_radius.tooltip: How far inside the room to look for fire, lava and other heat that warms the glass.
residuum.option.scan_radius.tooltip: How far around you, in blocks, to look for windows. Larger is slower.
residuum.option.scan_budget.tooltip: How many blocks are looked at each tick while searching for windows. Larger finds them sooner but costs more.
residuum.option.render_distance.tooltip: How far away effects are drawn. As the game: as far as the world is drawn. Whatever is off screen is never drawn.
residuum.option.tracked_windows.tooltip: The most windows kept up to date at once. Beyond that, the farthest are let go.
residuum.option.debug.tooltip: Outlines window faces and shows timings and values in the action bar.
residuum.option.coat_speed.tooltip: For testing: how many times faster hoarfrost, snow on walls and caps of snow build up and go again. At 30×, snow on a wall builds up in half a minute instead of a quarter of an hour. Keep it at 1× to play.
